verses.text: See how great a love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are. The world does not know us, because it did not know him.
Dear friends, we are children of God now. What we will be has not yet been shown. But we know that when he appears, we will be like him, because we will see him as he really is.
Everyone who has this hope in him keeps himself pure, just as Jesus is pure.
Everyone who sins breaks God's law. Sin is breaking God's law.
You know that Jesus came to take away our sins, and there is no sin in him.
Anyone who lives in him does not keep on sinning. Anyone who keeps on sinning has not seen him and does not know him.
Little children, do not let anyone lead you the wrong way. Anyone who does what is right is right with God, just as Jesus is right.
Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God came for this reason: to destroy the work of the devil.
Anyone who is born of God does not keep on sinning, because God's seed lives in him. He cannot keep on sinning, because he has been born of God.
This is how we can tell who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are. Anyone who does not do what is right is not from God, and neither is anyone who does not love his brother.
This is the message you heard from the beginning: we should love one another.
Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because the things he did were evil, and the things his brother did were right.
My brothers, do not be surprised if the world hates you.
We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. Anyone who does not love his brother still lives in death.
Anyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has life that lasts forever living in him.
This is how we know what love is: Jesus gave his life for us. So we should also give our lives for our brothers.
If anyone has enough to live on and sees his brother in need, but closes his heart against him, how can God's love be in him?
My little children, let us not love only with words or talk, but with what we do and in truth.
This is how we will know that we belong to the truth, and how we can calm our hearts in front of him:
even if our heart blames us, God is greater than our heart, and he knows everything.
Dear friends, if our heart does not blame us, we can come to God boldly.
And we receive from him whatever we ask, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.
This is his command: that we believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.
Anyone who obeys his commands lives in God, and God lives in him. And this is how we know that he lives in us: by the Spirit he has given us.
